# Tags that deployed to production without a GitHub Release, as measured on
# 2026-09-06. Read by scripts/check-release-record.mjs; the narrative, the
# method and the per-tag deploy outcomes are in docs/release-record-gap.md.
#
# This file is a BASELINE, not a permission. Its job is to stop the gap growing
# silently: a v* tag that is not listed here and has no GitHub Release after the
# grace period fails the release-record check. Every line here is a release
# record the owner still owes, and the correct edit to this file is a deletion
# after the release is published — never an addition.
#
# Blank lines and lines starting with `#` are ignored.
